events.summary: A big kid, Perrie runs errands for a watchmaker and enters the boxing ring for prize money, earning the nickname Perrie the Pulverizer.
events.quote: Perrie swore he'd do right by his friend and entered the boxing ring for some prize money

events.summary: When a getaway car heads for his table, Perrie slams it into the pavement and saves the watchmaker's life; the Brokers offer him a job.
events.quote: He saved the old man's life, though the watch didn't make it.

events.summary: Perrie refuses to punish a child who broke a contract and falls out with his family.
events.quote: until he refused to punish a child who had broken his contract

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion, Perrie and the Brokers side with the returned angels and join the resistance.
events.quote: Perrie and the Brokers sided with the returned angels and joined the resistance

relations.quote: He is the toughest agent the Brokers have on retainer.
before joining Kros on a mission to recover Jolene
